name: activity-feed
title: Activity feed
description: A chronological event list: who did what, when, with status badges.

standards.purpose: Show what happened, newest first, with the actor attached.
useWhen: Operators need the recent history of a scope.
doNotUseWhen: Events need action — pair the feed with its tool, don't strand it.

rules.check: Every event names its actor and its time; system events are labeled as such.
